method: Whole-file manual reading of TreeListControl header and implementation in complete ranges; pinned bytes verified. No Windows runtime.
findings: Visible-item VIEWSTATE is stored in a process-static map keyed by item pointer, including control pointer, indent, icon and cached rectangles. Access is partly mutex-protected; GetViewState returns pointer after shared lock release and is explicitly UI-thread-only. This does not establish arbitrary-thread lifetime safety.

SetVisible(false) removes view state then forgets async icon lookup; control-wide ClearViewStates erases matching entries without per-item Forget in this method. Earlier icon delivery identity checks remain separate protection, not proof of all teardown paths.

Expand gathers all direct child pointers, marks visible and inserts batch. Width auto-sizing examines only first50children when scrolling. Settled file tree sorts child batch only; other expansion sorts entire list. No benchmark or maximum-memory claim.

Collapse walks contiguous deeper rows iteratively, removes their view states and bulk list rows, and moves focus to parent when needed. Child-removal notifications and ancestor-aware Compare remain recursive on tree depth.

Selection normalization deselects a selected descendant when its mapped ancestor is selected, preventing double-counted selected subtrees in this view. Linked wrapper identity and GetAncestorCheckItem determine scope; filesystem identity is not checked by this rule.

Double-click opens linked file or toggles non-file expansion. Context menu hides hardlink action outside duplicate view, but comment claiming identical content is not a byte-equality guarantee: earlier duplicate sampling/hash and execution validation limitations still apply.
Context menu object remains a control member so queued WM_MENUCOMMAND retains menu lifetime. Selection/focus is carried by item pointers; model mutation coordination remains necessary.

DrawNode multiplies indent by row-height-based step without explicit extreme-depth overflow guard. Header reorder optionally blocks moving column zero; actual notification assumptions and deep-tree behavior remain unqualified.
limits: No Windows selection, expansion, sorting, icon teardown, hardlink action, deep-tree or memory/performance tests executed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
